pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   C. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Simple postures? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Simple postures.
   B. Apply the teaching of Simple postures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Simple postures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Simple postures has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Places of Worship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of Worship.
   B. Say Places of Worship has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Places of Worship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Say Names of Scriptures has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures.
   C. Use Names of Scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Places of Worship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain The Enlightened Beings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. A — Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. D — Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

8. B — Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
